newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fifteen killed in night attack on Algiers outskirts.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen killed in night attack on Algiers outskirts.

text.p: Suspected Moslem fundamentalists killed 15 civilians, including 10 women, by cutting their throats and decapitating some, on the outskirts of Algiers during Thursday night, witnesses said on Friday.
"They were killed on a farm at Ali Baba during the night but it's not clear at what time exactly," one resident said.
The victims were all from one family. Residents nearby said two other family members, both men, were badly wounded but managed to escape. Some of those killed were also mutilated, one resident said.

Algerian authorities blame Moslem fundamentalists for a series of attacks on isolated farms and villages in which scores of people have died since November. The authorities have also blamed them for bombs in the capital particularly since the start on January 10 of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.

Around 400 people have been killed since November, nearly five years after the start of a campaign by Moslem rebels to overthrow the authorities. About 60,000 people have died since the conflict started.
